Area.evidence_source: The participants' experiences of adverse childhood events and violence were strongly represented as contributors to their suicidality and refected inequities in relations of power. The participants detailed many forms of abuse at the hands of people in positions of power, such as parents and older family members across their life-course; however, violence featured in the participants' narratives of their childhood and adolescence. For many, these violent and challenging starts to life were described as the root cause of many of their adult life difculties, including their mental health struggles and suicidality.
